# ChronoGrid (Calendar 02) — Task Outline & Design Notes

## Overview

- **Source**: ColorLib Calendar 02 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/calendar-02/`)
- **New Name**: `chronogrid`
- **Package**: `@free-react-templates/chronogrid`
- **Deploy Target**: `chronogrid.free.componentdock.com`

## Structure & Section Order

1. **Header / Navbar**: Brand logo, navigation links (Calendar, Schedule, Events, About), and "New Event" CTA.
2. **Hero / Overview Banner**: Welcome greeting, quick stats (upcoming events, active reminders), and primary date badge.
3. **Calendar View Section**: Interactive month grid with day cells, status indicators, and previous/next month controls.
4. **Event Details / Schedule Sidebar**: Detailed listing of events for the selected date, time badges, and quick action buttons.
5. **Quick Add / Appointment Form**: Form inputs for creating new events (Title, Time, Category).
6. **Footer**: Copyright, links, and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design & Fidelity Notes

- **Colors**: Clean slate background with indigo primary accents to match the professional planning aesthetic observed in the template screenshot.
- **Interactivity**: Fully responsive state handling for month navigation, date selection, and event creation.
